title: matthiola incana
intro: Matthiola incana, commonly known as the Shepherds Needle or White Stock, is a flowering plant in the Brassicaceae family. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and providing relief from stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Matthiola incana include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anxiolytic effects. The plant's health benefits include improving sleep quality, reducing oxidative stress, and supporting the immune system.
